title: Nucleic Acid Purification and PCR Preparation
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Create CSV of mix destinations
steps.instruction: Prepare a .csv file that lists each source mix tube and the range of destination wells in the PCR plate. Use the header: mix tube,PCR plate start well,PCR plate end well. Example rows: A1,A1,H2; B1,A3,H6; C1,A7,H8; D1,A9,H12. Download the template if needed, edit it in Google Sheets, MS Excel, or Apple Numbers, then export as a .csv file.

steps.title: Enter pipette configuration
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, input the mount side for the P1000 single‑channel pipette, specify the number of capsules to fill, and set the volume (µL) to fill each capsule.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the Download button to obtain the Opentrons Python protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, choose Upload Protocol, and select the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons temperature module on the deck and insert the 96‑well aluminum block holding a Biozym 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL). Load the custom 24‑cuvette racks for Greiner Bio‑One Vacuette tubes (1‑4), the 4‑in‑1 tube rack with a 4×6 insert for Eppendorf 1.5 mL Safe‑Lock Snap‑Cap tubes, the USA Scientific 12‑channel reservoir (22 mL, catalog #1061‑8150), and tipracks for the P20 single‑channel and P300 multi‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for each piece of labware, each tiprack, and each pipette (P20 single‑channel GEN2 and P300 multi‑channel). Follow the on‑screen prompts and consult the support articles for tips.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated nucleic‑acid purification and PCR preparation. The robot will prompt you to refill tipracks for the P20 and P300 pipettes when necessary.

steps.title: Robot transfers PCR mixes
steps.instruction: The automated protocol will move the specified PCR mixes from the 1.5 mL tubes to the corresponding wells in the PCR plate as defined in the CSV file.
